en.title: Shortest Time to Visit Servers on a Ring
en.description:
Servers numbered 1..total form a ring, and moving between adjacent servers takes 1. You may start at any server in the list to visit. Find the shortest time to visit all the specified servers.

Standard input/output, examples and judging were written independently by CSWork; conventions marked as this site's do not claim to be the source's original limits.
en.input: The first line contains total n (1≤n≤total≤100000); the second line contains the n server numbers to visit (1..total). A repeated number only needs to be visited once.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: Example 1: the largest gap has length 3, and the ring length 8 minus 3 gives 5; for example, going from 4 toward 2 and then around to 7 takes 5 steps in total. Example 2: there is only one target, so you start there and the time is 0. Example 3: walking 3 consecutive steps along the ring visits all four points.
hints: Sort and deduplicate the points to visit, find the largest gap along the ring between adjacent points, and the answer is the ring length minus that largest gap.
